summary: Round 2 focused on the NEW self-service account deletion (DELETE /api/auth/me) plus regressions. Backend: 24/24 pytest tests pass (21 previous + 3 new self-delete tests) against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): full flow verified — register -> tabs -> Profile -> reminder-time-button opens reminder-picker, preset selectable, save-reminder-time triggers success toast 'Подсетници стижу у 09:00'; delete-account-button opens delete-account-modal, cancel-delete-account dismisses, confirm-delete-account soft-deletes user and documents and navigates to /welcome. Post-delete requests return 401 as expected. Admin login with admin@evidencija.rs / puzopb returns is_admin=true and passes all admin flows. No new expo/react-native deprecation issues introduced.

minor.issue: Returns 500 when EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is 'placeholder' (upstream 401). Expected per spec (native-only). Test accepts 201/500/502.

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking, carried over from iter 1.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents (originates in RN Web modal/backdrop). Non-blocking.

action_items: (optional) Migrate remaining 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' equivalents to silence RN Web warnings.
(optional) Migrate any props.pointerEvents usages to style.pointerEvents (likely in a modal/backdrop component).
critical_code_review_comments: DELETE /api/auth/me implementation (server.py:461-469) correctly soft-deletes both the user (users.deleted_at) and their documents (documents.deleted_at). Subsequent auth uses `current_user` which filters out deleted users -> old token now returns 401. Verified by test_delete_me_soft_deletes_user_and_docs.

profile.tsx uses proper Modal + testIDs (delete-account-modal, confirm-delete-account, cancel-delete-account, reminder-picker, reminder-time-button, save-reminder-time). No accessibility or wiring issues detected.
server.py still ~717 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth/documents/subscription/admin) as it grows.
